title: SLA view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's sla view: owner-response SLA clocks over the scope's findings (named products and teams, else every repository; false positives and hardening excluded) as of as_of, one block per profile of the deployment's SLA policy. Profiles are different clocks over the same findings. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

clock_start.description: The policy's clock-start rule, from the sla-clock-start registry.

as_of.description: The point in time the clocks are read at: the filter's, else when the view was built.

profiles.description: One block per policy profile: the default profile first, then by name.

source.description: Where the SLA policy came from.

url.description: The source's URL, raw; null when none is recorded.

note.description: A note on the source, raw; null when none.

counts.description: Every in-scope finding lands in exactly one count; unclocked and out-of-profile findings are shown, never dropped.

open_in_sla.description: Open, due on or after as_of.

open_no_sla.description: Open, in the profile's scope but with no deadline (tracked, never overdue).

unclocked.description: Open with no clock start (no report and no decision).

resolved_met.description: Resolved on or before its deadline.

resolved_unclocked.description: Resolved with no clock start or no resolution time.

out_of_profile_scope.description: Outside the profile's severity scope and below its CVSS floor.

description.description: The profile's description, raw; null when none.

resolved_compliance_pct.description: resolved_met as a percentage of resolved_met + resolved_breached, to one decimal; null when nothing resolved was clocked.

median_days_to_resolve.description: Per severity (unrated for findings without one), the median whole days from clock start to resolution of the clocked resolved findings. Only severities with a resolution appear. A value can be negative when a finding was resolved before its clock started (for example, fixed before it was filed).

overdue_by_severity.description: Open overdue findings per severity (unrated for findings without one); only severities with one appear.

teams.description: One row per owner team with an overdue finding, most overdue first, then by team name. A finding with no owner counts under (unassigned).

escalations.description: The escalation digest: overdue findings, critical first and unrated last, then most days overdue first; at most 100. Generated for human review, never sent.

team.description: The owner team's name, raw, or (unassigned).

worst_days.description: The most whole days any of them is overdue.

repository_url.description: Raw registered URL, preserved as data.

severity.description: Effective severity; null when unrated (in scope through the profile's CVSS floor).

title.description: Raw untrusted finding title, truncated to 120 characters and preserved as data rather than authored Markdown or HTML.

teams.description: The repository's owner teams, raw, or (unassigned).

due.description: When the SLA fell due (before as_of).

days_overdue.description: Whole days from due to as_of.

clock_basis.description: What started the clock: the tracker filing, the first report or decision, or the first audit report.
